transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here because I know the new owners are out to destroy my name, no matter what anyone says. They are actively trying to ruin my reputation and make sure I can't find work anywhere else.
Along with these worries about the new owners, how has your mood been lately? Have you been feeling consistently down, sad, or hopeless?

My mood has been incredibly low, like I'm stuck in a dark, heavy, and drained state where everything feels completely hopeless and pointless. This constant down feeling started about two months ago when they cut my hours, and now it feels like all the color has been sucked out of my life.
Did these thoughts about the owners trying to ruin your reputation start before you began feeling depressed, or have you ever had these thoughts during times when your mood felt completely normal?

No, I’ve never had these thoughts when my mood was normal. They only started after I had already sunk into this dark, drained state where everything felt hopeless. Before these last two months, I never believed anyone was trying to sabotage me.
Have you ever experienced periods in your life lasting at least several days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually high, full of energy, or needing very little sleep?

No, I've never had times like that where I felt unusually high or full of energy. I've never gone days needing very little sleep or feeling on top of the world. It's really been the exact opposite, especially lately.
Have you ever experienced a period in your past, before these last two months, where you felt similarly depressed, down, or hopeless for weeks at a time?
No, I’ve never experienced a period of depression like this in my past. I don't recall ever feeling this hopeless or drained before these last few months.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a severe depressive episode of approximately two months' duration, characterized by a persistently low, drained mood, hopelessness, and loss of pleasure. Accompanying these depressive symptoms are persecutory delusions (believing the new owners are actively trying to ruin their reputation), which developed only after the onset of the depressive mood. There is no prior history of depressive, manic, or hypomanic episodes, confirming a single severe depressive episode with psychotic symptoms.
